name: AlayaWorld (image + text only)
model_version: AlayaWorld da3 interactive path: merged_infer.safetensors (AR + DMD, 4 steps) on LTX-2.3 22B, Gemma 3 12B text encoder, Depth-Anything-3 spatial memory; upstream reactor/alayaworld.py adapter settings

weights.repo: AlayaLab/AlayaWorld (merged_infer.safetensors, revision pinned in reactor/alayaworld.yaml) + google/gemma-3-12b-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized (gated on Hugging Face; also available from ModelScope) + depth-anything/DA3NESTED-GIANT-LARGE-1.1, all at the revisions pinned in reactor/alayaworld.yaml

notes: Image-to-video world model: the released interactive path starts from an image, so only the i2v (image + text) track is registered. 960x544 at 24 fps, 32-frame chunks generated live through AlayaLab's own interactive adapter (reactor/alayaworld.py, the browser demo's model class) with its serving settings. A prompt change applies from the next chunk; the block prompt is '<init prompt>\n<latest instruction>' and camera_control text is given as prompt text (the six native camera axes are held at zero, i.e. a static camera). Mid-session reference images have no model input (reference_update unsupported). See README.
